description: This Java class handles delete commands for client identifiers in the Apache Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and orchestrates the deletion operation via ClientIdentifierWritePlatformService.

classes.name: DeleteClientIdentifierCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles delete commands for client identifiers, annotated with @Service and @CommandType. Implements processing logic via the ClientIdentifierWritePlatformService.

methods.name: DeleteClientIdentifierCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with ClientIdentifierWritePlatformService via dependency injection.
